    rb=[-1]+rs+[h]; cb=[-1]+cs+[w]
    out=[]

        line=[]
        for l,r in zip(cb,cb[1:]):
            counts=Counter(x for row in grid[a+1:b] for x in row[l+1:r] if x!=sep)
            background=max(counts,key=counts.get)
            marked=sum(n for c,n in counts.items() if c!=background)>=2
            line.append(1 if marked else background)
        out.append(line)
    return out
